STEP 3 - Items: Whole almonds (about 35-40 nuts, some split/halved).

STEP 4 - Area: Almonds cover roughly the upper-center region of the plate, about 20% of the vessel area.

STEP 7 - Energy: Almonds ≈ 579 kcal/100 g (raw/dry-roasted values, ~580-600). 42 g x 5.8 ≈ 244 kcal.

STEP 8 - Sanity check: A visible handful of about 40 almonds at roughly 40 g and ~240 kcal is plausible for what is shown.
